# Norwegian Kelly list (vendored)

Frequency ranking source for the lexicon's `frequency_rank` field.

## Files

- `kelly-word-list-norwegian-english.xls` — the raw source, byte-for-byte as
  downloaded. 6,000 rows, sheet `Ark1`, columns `Norwegian | POS | English`.
  **Rank is implicit = row order** (row 1 = rank 1).
- `kelly.csv` — normalized, diffable derivation: `rank,lemma,pos_kelly,pos_ud,english`.
  Generated from the `.xls` by `ordbokene.frequency.convert_xls_to_csv`
  (`pos_ud` = the lexicon Universal-Dependencies POS mapped from `pos_kelly`).
  One `.xls` row has a blank lemma and is dropped, so this has 5,999 rows with
  ranks spanning 1–6000 (one gap).
- `match-report.json` — generated by `python pipeline.py frequency`: how many
  Kelly keys matched the current export, how many were unmatched (closed-class
  words / spelling variants not in the lexicon), and which `(lemma, pos)` keys
  matched more than one lemma (homographs).

## Source & licence

- **Source:** Norwegian Kelly list, Universitetet i Oslo, Tekstlaboratoriet
  (https://www.hf.uio.no/iln/english/about/organisation/text-laboratory/services/kelly.html,
  tekstlab.uio.no/kelly).
- **Downloaded:** 2026-07-04 from
  `https://www.hf.uio.no/iln/om/organisasjon/tekstlab/tjenester/kelly-word-list-norwegian-english.xls`
- **Licence:** CC BY-SA 4.0 — https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/
- **Citation:** Kilgarriff, A., Charalabopoulou, F., et al. 2014. "Corpus-based
  vocabulary lists for language learners for nine languages." *Language
  Resources and Evaluation* 48:121–163.

The Kelly list has no CEFR column (CEFR exists only in the Swedish Kelly list).

## Regenerating `kelly.csv`

```python
from pathlib import Path
from ordbokene.frequency import convert_xls_to_csv
convert_xls_to_csv(
    Path("data/vendor/kelly/kelly-word-list-norwegian-english.xls"),
    Path("data/vendor/kelly/kelly.csv"),
)
```

(Requires `pandas` + an `.xls` reader; dev-only. The runtime `frequency` stage
reads only `kelly.csv`.)
